messages:
Ibrahim Noor: Morning all — Ibrahim here, joining Platform Tools from London (GMT). First-day checklist questions: who sends MDM invite, how do I get VPN and Git access, and is there a quick pointer for local dev setup? Tiny fun fact: I bake sourdough on weekends and will happily share starter if anyones nearby :bread:

Lina Gomez: Welcome Ibrahim!! Im your onboarding buddy. Ill run a 15m intro at 11am GMT to show the repo layout and local dev scripts. Sam handles hardware/MDM and VPN, Ops Bot will create your onboarding ticket.

Sam (IT): Hi Ibrahim  welcome. Sent MDM invite to the personal email on your profile. Laptop shipping scheduled, ETA 2-4 business days. For SSH: generate ed25519 key and paste the public key into the onboarding form. Example: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ibrahim@redwood.com"```

Ibrahim Noor: Thanks Sam. For the VPN, do you need any additional approval?

Sam (IT): For standard VPN and GitHub org access no extra approvals. For infra or privileged clusters we need the signed access form (Ben from infra would handle that). Paste your public key into the form and ping me here when done.

Lina Gomez: Ill DM you a short checklist with channels to join (#platform-tools, #devops-help), the local dev readme, and our recommended first PRs. Also we have a weekday lunchtime sourdough channel? Kidding  but drop a pic in #random when you get a chance.

Ops Bot: Onboarding ticket created (ID: OB-4387654321). Tasks: MDM invite, Laptop shipment, SSH key, GitHub invite, Intro sync. Owners: Sam (IT), Lina Gomez.

Ibrahim Noor: All set  uploaded pubkey and accepted the MDM invite. See you at 11am GMT, and yes Ill post a starter pic later :grin:
